propositions: Close must validate that plan material and signatures remain current and compatible during execution without blocking on code freshness changes

A separately attested plan-review gate runs inside the transaction lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, rejecting unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, material-drift, and phase-incompatible reviews
Pin drift and missing pins block only when enforce_plan_material_pins is true; all other validity failures (signature, registry, phase, material, malformed metadata) block unconditionally
The close gate returns exact verdict names and remediation instructions on failure, never invokes models or network, and fails closed as unavailable on unexpected local exceptions
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass are preserved; structural child-closure rules are never bypassed
